description: This file defines the Thread class and related thread-local storage template in the Thunder::Core namespace. It includes thread management functionalities such as starting, stopping, suspending, and setting thread priorities, as well as thread-local storage handling for different platforms (Windows and POSIX).

classes.name: ThreadLocalStorageType
classes.description: Template class managing thread-local storage for a specified type, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and POSIX.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: Class representing a thread, providing control over thread lifecycle, priority, and context, with platform-specific thread handling.

methods.name: ThreadLocalStorageType::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance managing thread-local storage.

methods.name: ThreadLocalStorageType::Context
methods.description: Accesses the thread-local storage instance for the current thread.

methods.name: ThreadLocalStorageType::IsSet
methods.description: Checks if thread-local storage is set for the current thread.

methods.name: Thread::Thread
methods.description: Constructor initializing a thread object with optional stack size and name.

methods.name: Thread::State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the thread.

methods.name: Thread::Wait
methods.description: Waits for the thread to reach a specific state within a timeout.

methods.name: Thread::Yield
methods.description: Yields execution to other threads, with a count-based mechanism and optional sleep.

methods.name: Thread::GetContext
methods.description: Template method to access thread-local storage of a specific type.

methods.name: Thread::Signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the thread.

methods.name: Thread::GetCallstack
methods.description: Retrieves the call stack for debugging (only if __DEBUG__ is defined).

methods.name: Thread::Worker
methods.description: Pure virtual method to be implemented with the thread's work logic.

methods.name: Thread::ThreadName
methods.description: Gets or sets the thread's name.
